svg.title: Inside a NiFi cluster namespace
svg.desc: Deployment diagram of what the nifi-operator creates in one NiFi cluster namespace: users reach two node groups of NiFi 2.12 pods through a client Service and optional Route or HTTPRoute, the pods talk mTLS to each other over the headless Service, and they elect the cluster coordinator and primary node through Kubernetes Leases with ConfigMap state instead of ZooKeeper, reading rendered config and secrets mounted into every pod.

g.text: same pod spec: CSI TLS + 4 repo PVCs

svg.text: xN = pod replicas · alt backend: external ZooKeeper
